Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
> > http://web.tiscali.it/Vampirismus/kindimp.jpg

Nice art!

> Yes, very nice. Much too expensive for my taste though, especially B4 the
> Temporis card came out. It could cost, like, 3 : it takes an action
anyway,
> an older vampire, and it can be intercepted !!

Being able to contest someone else's vampire is an exceptionally powerful
ability. Contest the right vampire and you caould totally screw someone's
deck. Being able to buy someone's vampire is harsh enough, ask anyone on the
recieving ends of a Hostile Takeover or Temptaion of Greater Power. Combine
Kindred Impersonation with Clio's Kiss and you've got a pretty dirty combo.
As for being blockable, well, it is an Obfuscate card so a Fogotten
Labyrinth(S) would make it at 3 stealth, pretty hard to block. If using it
I'd go so far as to play Daring the Dawn make it unblockable, since the
vampires are going to contest and make them both leave play anyway and when
it comes back it comes back into the ready region ( by card text ). 5 is a
lot of blood but probably a fair cost. I don't know that the card needs a
capacity & younger restriction but it definately needs to have something to
prevent weenies from using it, either capacity or a younger restriction
would probably do. The restrictions make an othewise extremely powerful card
difficult to use with any kind of frequency, which is a good thing.

Thanks, but i think that card is almost balanced (in cost) as it is.
Just a few considerations:
it would be an obfuscate-based strategy, it's very unlikely
that someone can block that action (forgotten labyrinth+lost in crowd
around,
mmmh just a direct intervention can save your (key) vamp from being
contested....).
With malkavians around (obf+dom), it becomes really powerful:
Kindred Impersonation + Thanks For the Donation, and
one can say bye - bye to his/her vamps....
Sure, it would be a strategy that works not too much against weenies,
but it would screw many other mostly-crypt-based decks
(above all, this is true with the new BL vampires around).
Maybe the cost can be lowered to 4, but not less than that.
(and i'm still not sure..:) )

Just my thought
